name: Walk In Ready
customer_outcome: Enter the meeting with informed questions
scope_description: Up to 3 units; 2-page meeting brief; 10 priority questions; short Brief audio; 3 business days.

name: Make It Make Sense Kit
customer_outcome: Help a customer explain the offer back
scope_description: Up to 5 units; educational explainer video target 4–7 min; 10-question FAQ; one-page explanation; 3 days.

name: Customer Question Kit
customer_outcome: Give consistent answers and identify open questions
scope_description: Up to 5 units including real customer questions; 20 FAQs; 10 objection responses; topic map; 3 days.

name: Find the Friction
customer_outcome: Identify customer-problem hypotheses to test
scope_description: Up to 15 accessible discussion/review sources; pain-point evidence table; customer language; interview questions.

name: Find Your Opening
customer_outcome: Identify a defensible positioning hypothesis
scope_description: Up to 3 competitors; dated feature/pricing evidence; gap analysis; positioning hypotheses.

name: Idea to MVP Brief
customer_outcome: Give an engineer a bounded implementation brief
scope_description: Audience/problem brief; prioritized MVP requirements; up to 3 user journeys; acceptance criteria; developer handoff prompt.

name: RFP Response Starter
ideal_buyer: B2B vendor responding to one RFP
customer_outcome: Prepare sourced answers and expose evidence gaps
scope_description: One RFP; up to 40 questions; requirements matrix; sourced draft answers; missing-information register.

name: Policy Gap Review
customer_outcome: Identify possible policy discrepancies for review
scope_description: One vendor document against one internal policy pack; up to 15 requirements; passage comparisons; possible discrepancies; reviewer questions.

name: Project Clarity Brief
customer_outcome: Clarify decisions, owners and next questions
scope_description: One project; stated decisions; actions; blockers; conflicting updates; next questions.

name: First Week Ready
customer_outcome: Help a new hire understand approved procedures
scope_description: One role guide; orientation video; native quiz target 15 questions; up to 8 approved-SOP units; 5 days.

name: Vendor Choice Brief
customer_outcome: Compare options against explicit requirements
scope_description: Up to 3 vendors and 8 criteria; up to 10 units incl. discovery; comparison; conditional recommendation; missing-evidence register; 5 days.

name: Voice of Customer Brief
customer_outcome: Find patterns without hiding contradictory feedback
scope_description: Up to 8 units of de-identified feedback; themes report; attributable quote/evidence table; concept infographic; 5 days.

name: Explain It Monthly
ideal_buyer: Seller with three recurring education topics
customer_outcome: Maintain a cadence of customer explanations
scope_description: 3 explainer kits/month: 3 videos, 3 FAQs, 3 one-page explanations; 5 units/topic, 15 total; prepaid monthly.

name: Executive Listening Desk
customer_outcome: Turn recurring source packs into usable briefings
scope_description: 4 weekly listening briefs; audio + one-page takeaway/questions report; 3 units/brief, 12 total; client supplies pack.

name: Team Learning Monthly
ideal_buyer: Team lead with recurring training needs
customer_outcome: Help the team understand recurring changes
scope_description: 2 modules/month; each guide, orientation video, quiz target 15; 6 units/module, 12 total; owner sign-off.

name: Customer Education Monthly
customer_outcome: Explain each topic across several formats
scope_description: 2 topic bundles/month; each video, infographic, 8–12 slide PDF, FAQ; 8 units/bundle, 16 total.

name: Decision Desk Monthly
customer_outcome: Make repeated decisions with documented tradeoffs
scope_description: 2 scoped decision briefs/month; evidence table, recommendation report, Debate/Critique audio; up to 3 options and 10 units each.

name: Knowledge Continuity Monthly
ideal_buyer: Team maintaining an evolving knowledge domain
customer_outcome: Reduce stale answers and preserve authoritative context
scope_description: One private notebook; 2 scheduled refresh batches; monthly change report, updated FAQ, change audio; first month organizes up to 10 units.

name: AI Choice Session
ideal_buyer: Business owner making one AI choice
customer_outcome: Choose the next useful step on one question
scope_description: 60 minutes; one question; up to 3 preread units; one-page next step; max 2 hours incl. prep.

name: Map Poke Scale Pressure-Proof Workshop
customer_outcome: Produce a decision map and staged pilot plan
scope_description: 90 minutes on one workflow; up to 5 units; decision map; challenge register; staged pilot plan; no implementation.

name: Founder Clarity Bundle
customer_outcome: Prepare related explanation and meeting assets
scope_description: Walk In Ready + Make It Make Sense + Customer Question Kit, one offer/audience/meeting; up to 13 units; proposed 5 days.

name: Team Readiness Bundle
ideal_buyer: Manager onboarding one role and process
customer_outcome: Clarify one role and its core process
scope_description: First Week Ready plus one process explanation report, process infographic and ten exception questions; one role/process; up to 13 units. The process component is a bundle-only module, not an active standalone service.

name: AMA Clarity Workflow Workbook Bundle
customer_outcome: Organize source material and review generated work
scope_description: Three self-guided AMA PDFs: Explain My Offer, Walk In Ready, Customer Question Harvest. No tool account, software subscription or done-for-you generation included. Monthly Topic Planner is not included in this three-workbook product.
